name: Celeste LaRue
caption: The first World Champion of Barely Legal, crowned at GoldRush on 16 June 2007, who held the belt twice before Crimson Skull took it in September 2007.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: first World champion at GoldRush on 16 June 2007, who lost the belt to Dr. Demento, won it back in a Circus High Top Death Match on 2 September 2007 and lost it to Crimson Skull on 23 September.

name: Dr. Demento
caption: Took the World title from Celeste LaRue on 12 August 2007 and lost it back to her three weeks later.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: beat Celeste LaRue for the World title on eXposed on 12 August 2007 and lost it back on 2 September.

name: Crimson Skull
caption: World champion of Barely Legal Wrestling Alliance from 23 September 2007, billed against Foley Anderson on its 6 April 2008 card; at Wrestling Unplugged from Thankful Sins on 23 November 2008, where its news calls him 'former JWF champion' and has him and Hallow Wicked beat Twilight Rayn and Percy.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: beat Celeste LaRue for the World title at Violence on 23 September 2007; the 6 April 2008 card lists his win over Foley Anderson.

Thankful Sins (23 November 2008), where he walks out after the main event ('Crimson Skull is here in Wrestling Unplugged!!!'); the eighth Parental Advisory, where he makes his in-ring debut ('making his debut here in Wrestling Unplugged'), the ninth and the tenth, and its roster page.

notes: The same ring name on the older fed's World title list and on Wrestling Unplugged's roster page; the two companies share owners and roster.

name: Akemi Amaterasu
caption: Held both the World and the Grand Prix belts in 2007: the Prime Time lineage from August and the World title from October until Halloween Massacre.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: World champion from an October 2007 eXposed until Halloween Massacre, and Prime Time (Grand Prix) champion from 12 August until 9 December 2007.

name: Barelai Von'Vicious
caption: Won the World title at Halloween Massacre on 31 October 2007; by the fed's own telling he was destroyed that night and died, and the show went on without him.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: beat Akemi Amaterasu for the World title at Halloween Massacre on 31 October 2007; the eXposed of the following week recaps him winning 'the Universal Championship' and being destroyed in the ring by the return of Johnny Stylez, and the Thanksgiving-week show mourns him.

name: Hallow Wicked
caption: The Lord of the Vampires: twice World champion of Barely Legal Wrestling Alliance (the tournament of 12 November 2007 and the eXposed of 6 April 2008), a Wrestling Unplugged signing in September 2008 who feuded with Eric Draven and Twilight Rayn, and 'the former Barley Legal Champion' at Screaming For Vengeance in June 2009.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: won the World Heavyweight Championship Tournament on 12 November 2007, lost the belt to Mastermind at Violence on 30 March 2008 and won it back on eXposed on 6 April; the Wrestling Unplugged show of 29 September 2008 calls him 'the former BLWA Champion'.
Its Screaming For Vengeance (introduced as 'the former Barley Legal Champion'; lost to Skit-Zo) and Parental Advisory 11 (main event).
Its Parental Advisory cards from 22 September 2008; the show of 29 September calls him 'the former BLWA Champion'.

notes: Wrestling Unplugged's second Parental Advisory (29 September 2008) calls Hallow Wicked 'the former BLWA Champion', and its staff page traces its owners from the older fed.

name: Mastermind
caption: Held the BLLV belt and, for one week, the World title in spring 2008, losing the World title back to Hallow Wicked on 6 April.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: BLLV champion from 17 February 2008 and World champion from 30 March to 6 April 2008, beaten both times by name opponents on eXposed.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Steve Smith
caption: Held the Prime Time title from December 2007 and the BLLV title for two weeks in February 2008.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: Prime Time champion from 16 December 2007 and BLLV champion from 3 to 17 February 2008.

name: Drake Daniels
caption: A wrestler who held the BLLV title of Barely Legal Wrestling Alliance twice in 2008, fought in the See No Evil tournament for Wrestling Unplugged's first World title, was released that November and billed as returning on 29 December 2008, and won the Lugar title at Screaming For Vengeance in June 2009 for a week.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: BLLV champion before 3 February 2008 and again from 9 to 16 March; the 6 April 2008 card lists his win over Johnny Saint.
Its Screaming For Vengeance (beat Chad Vargas for the Lugar Championship) and Parental Advisory 11 (lost the One Shot Championship to Skit-Zo).
Its roster page, the first Parental Advisory's card and the 29 December card ('He Returns').

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

notes: The same ring name on the older fed's BLLV list and in Wrestling Unplugged's first card and its 'returns' card of December 2008; the two companies share owners and roster.

name: Barney Green
caption: Held the BLLV belt for a week in March 2008 and was billed against Jaden Lee on 6 April.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: BLLV champion from 16 to 23 March 2008; the 6 April card has him lose to Jaden Lee, and the fed's own front page rumours name him 'the next world champion'.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Porter MaCleod
caption: The Scottish-billed Real Deal: Prime Time and BLLV champion of Barely Legal Wrestling Alliance in early 2008, who joined Wrestling Unplugged in October 2008 with the JWF belt, merged it into the Prime Time title at The Bleeding, and returned at Screaming For Vengeance in June 2009.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: Prime Time champion from 1 January to 9 March 2008 and BLLV champion from 23 March 2008; the 6 April card lists his win over Foley Anderson.
Its Screaming For Vengeance ('The Real Deal Porter MaCleod' greeting Eric Evans, then a run-in) and Parental Advisory 11 (won the main event with Jinx).
Its Rankings page (Prime Time champion) and Short Circuit page (champion from The Bleeding on 19 October 2008); its Parental Advisory cards.

notes: The same ring name on the older fed's Prime Time and BLLV lists and on Wrestling Unplugged's, where the Prime Time belt is a title he brought from another federation; the two companies share owners and roster.

name: Dari Wheeler
caption: The last holder of the BLLV belt, after a Rumble on the Mass Effect show of 30 April 2008.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: became the last BLLV champion after the Rumble on Mass Effect on 30 April 2008, a belt vacated when the fed closed.

name: Bobby Azula
caption: Held the Prime Time title for a week in December 2007 and was the victim of a masked stalker in November.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: Prime Time champion from 9 December 2007 until Steve Smith took the belt on 16 December; a captured eXposed of November 2007 stages a masked man's trap for him.

name: Saigon
caption: The first Grand Prix champion, from GoldRush on 16 June 2007.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: beat Portini to become the first Grand Prix champion at GoldRush on 16 June 2007.

name: Portini
caption: Lost the first Grand Prix final to Saigon at GoldRush on 16 June 2007.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: the beaten finalist when Saigon became the first Grand Prix champion at GoldRush on 16 June 2007.

name: Stoner
caption: A stoner gimmick wrestler who won the Grand Prix belt in a Rumble in July 2007 and shared the Tag Team titles with Dark Wolf.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: won a Rumble to become Grand Prix champion on 28 July 2007, lost it on 12 August, and was a Tag Team title challenger and champion in 2007; the fed's profile page gives him a parole officer who walks to the ring with him.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Knon
caption: Stoner's partner in the match for the first Tag Team titles, 16 June 2007.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: partnered Stoner in the final of the first Tag Team title match at GoldRush on 16 June 2007.

name: Johnny Mara
caption: Partnered Stoner against the Ring Generals for the Tag Team titles in 2007.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: partnered Stoner in a Tag Team title loss to the Ring Generals; the page prints the date as 8/16/08, which cannot be placed.

name: Dark Wolf
caption: Stoner's partner when the pair won the Tag Team titles at Violence on 31 August 2007.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: beat the Ring Generals with Stoner for the Tag Team titles at Violence on 31 August 2007.

name: Desperado
caption: The first and only holder of the TVX championship, from GoldRush on 16 June 2007.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: 'first and only TVX Champion' at GoldRush on 16 June 2007.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Dave Johnson
caption: Took the Prime Time title from Scorpio on 6 April 2008, the last holder before the fed closed.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: beat Scorpio for the Prime Time title on eXposed on 6 April 2008; the card of that night lists the same match.

name: Scorpio
caption: Held the Prime Time title for four weeks in spring 2008.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: Prime Time champion from 9 March to 6 April 2008, beaten by Dave Johnson.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Shawn Hunt
caption: Tag Team champion with Jaden Lee from 1 January 2008.

tenures.source: Its championship history page: won the Tag Team titles with Jaden Lee at New Year's Hangover on 1 January 2008 and lost them to DOA at Violence on 30 March; the December 2007 eXposed names him in a three-way with Mastermind and Devastator.

name: Jaden Lee
caption: A tweener billed the IT girl: Tag Team champion of Barely Legal Wrestling Alliance with Shawn Hunt from 1 January 2008 and winner of the first match on its 6 April card; as Alyssa Lee, 'the artist formally known as Jaden Lee', she won Wrestling Unplugged's first women's match at Thankful Sins on 23 November 2008, lost a One Shot title match to CJ Gates on 15 December and won a place in the Psycho Circus Death Match on 22 December.

tenures.source: Its championship history page (Tag Team champion with Shawn Hunt from 1 January 2008); its own profile page, captured 18 March 2008; the 6 April 2008 card lists her win over Barney Green.

The sixth Parental Advisory announces her ('Coming soon, The Fatal Attraction, Alyssa Lee', 'the artist formally known as Jaden Lee'); Thankful Sins (23 November 2008, the first women's match), the eighth card's dark match, the ninth (a One Shot title match) and the tenth (a place in the Psycho Circus Death Match).

name: Brian Cady
caption: Lost the Tag Team titles with Shawn Hunt on 30 March 2008 and won on the 6 April card.

tenures.source: Its championship history page (printed 'Brain Cady'): lost the Tag Team titles with Shawn Hunt to DOA at Violence on 30 March 2008; the 6 April 2008 card spells it Brian Cady and lists his win over Zhenshi Peng.

name: Johnny Saint
caption: Billed against Drake Daniels on the 6 April 2008 eXposed.

tenures.source: Its 6 April 2008 card: lost to Drake Daniels in the second match.

name: Zhenshi Peng
caption: Billed against Brian Cady on the 6 April 2008 eXposed.

tenures.source: Its 6 April 2008 card: lost to Brian Cady in the third match.

name: Foley Anderson
caption: Billed twice on the 6 April 2008 eXposed, against Crimson Skull and Porter MaCleod; the front page's rumour list says he signed after a stint in rehab.

tenures.source: Its 6 April 2008 card: lost to Crimson Skull in the fourth match and to Porter MaCleod in the seventh.

name: Black Death
caption: Billed against Requiem on the 6 April 2008 eXposed.

tenures.source: Its 6 April 2008 card: lost to Requiem in the fifth match; its recap names him Johnny Hall's partner at Violence.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Requiem
caption: A seven-foot-five heel called the Sorrow, managed by Eric Evans: he beat Black Death on the last eXposed card of Barely Legal Wrestling Alliance on 6 April 2008, was Wrestling Unplugged's first World champion from See No Evil on 14 September 2008 to the end of its surviving record, and beat Jinx for the Elite title at Screaming For Vengeance in June 2009.

tenures.source: Its 6 April 2008 card: beat Black Death in the fifth match; the same card's recap calls him Porter's new guy.
Its Screaming For Vengeance ('Here is your winner and NEW Elite Champion, Requiem!') and Parental Advisory 11 (champion in the main event).
Its World Championship History (See No Evil, 14 September 2008), its roster page and its profile page; its Thankful Sins and tenth Parental Advisory pages keep him champion.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

notes: Wrestling Unplugged's own profile of Requiem says Eric Evans, 'former co-owner of BLWA', brought him in 'before BLW closed'; the older fed's own 6 April 2008 card has him beat Black Death.

name: Johnny Hall
caption: The owner who opened each Barely Legal Wrestling Alliance eXposed with his co-owner Tyler Sparks and, by the next company's account, closed the fed; he returned to Wrestling Unplugged in October 2008 as Director of Operations, hostile to the owner who had bought the older fed's rights.

tenures.source: Its eXposed pages, which open with 'Johnny Hall and Tyler Sparks' laughing in the ring and sign off with 'Hall'; Wrestling Unplugged's staff page calls him the owner of Barely Legal Wrestling Alliance.

Its staff page (28 December 2008): 'WU Director of Operations'; The Feed of 21 October 2008 opens on his return; Thankful Sins (23 November 2008) is his last scene, and the eighth Parental Advisory has Ari Chase replace him.

notes: Wrestling Unplugged's staff page says Johnny Hall 'came into the wrestling world as the owner of BLWA'; the older fed's own eXposed shows open with Hall.

name: Tyler Sparks
caption: Johnny Hall's partner in running the fed, who appears in the ring and in the recap of every captured eXposed.

tenures.source: Its eXposed pages, which open with 'Johnny Hall and Tyler Sparks' in the ring; Wrestling Unplugged's staff page calls him Johnny Hall's partner in the fed.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Ryder E
caption: Named the co-owner in each captured eXposed's opening recap, a role that also writes its main events.

tenures.source: Its eXposed pages: 'the Co-Owner Ryder E' in the opening recap of each show captured from November 2007 to February 2008.

name: Eric Evans
caption: Shown beside the co-owner of Barely Legal Wrestling Alliance in February 2008; co-owner of Wrestling Unplugged and then its Commissioner and Requiem's manager from September 2008, who turned on his charge in October; and at ringside for the Elite title match at Screaming For Vengeance in June 2009.

tenures.source: Its eXposed of February 2008, whose opening recap shows 'the Co-Owner Ryder E and Eric Evans'; Wrestling Unplugged's staff page calls him a former co-owner of the fed.
Its Screaming For Vengeance: Eric Evans at ringside for the Elite title match, greeting Porter MaCleod as 'old friend'.
Its staff page (28 December 2008): 'WU Co-Owner'; its shows have him as Commissioner and as Requiem's manager.

notes: Wrestling Unplugged's staff page calls Eric Evans a former co-owner of BLWA; the older fed's own February 2008 eXposed shows the co-owner and Eric Evans together.

name: Kid Styles
caption: A face billed the K.I.D., whose profile page lists six earlier federations and who 'loves to have fun'.

tenures.source: Its profile page, captured 28 November 2007: the K.I.D., a face from Orlando who lists other federations in his history.

name: Johnny Styles
caption: The wrestler SBK: 'Johnny SBK Stylez' returned at Halloween Massacre in Barely Legal Wrestling Alliance on 31 October 2007; a column on Wrestling Unplugged's news page follows him through other federations to March 2009; and in October 2009 he won the first 96 Revolution World title in a six-man cage and lost it to Nathan Lancaster on 3 November.

tenures.source: Its eXposed of November 2007: the opening recap of Halloween Massacre shows 'the return of Johnny SBK Stylez'.

Its Revolution pay-per-view (won the Chaotic Cage match: 'NEW 96 REVOULTION WORLD CHAMPION: JOHNNY STYLES') and its eXposes of 26 October, 3 November (lost the main event to Nathan Lancaster) and 9 November 2009 (attacked by Osh Vaughan).
